description: This file defines the internal mechanisms for managing Git references in the 'files' backend, including reference locking, reading, writing, renaming, reflog management, and packing optimization.

classes.name: ref_lock
classes.description: Represents a lock on a specific reference, including related metadata like reference name, lock file, old object ID, and usage count.

classes.name: files_ref_store
classes.description: Implementation of ref_store for filesystem-based references, maintaining configuration, caches, and associated data.

classes.name: ref_to_prune
classes.description: Linked list node for references scheduled for pruning, containing object ID and reference name.

classes.name: ref_iterator
classes.description: Abstract iterator for traversing references, with an internal implementation for files backend.

methods.name: void clear_loose_ref_cache(struct files_ref_store * refs)
methods.description: Clears the cache of loose references in the reference store.

methods.name: struct:ref_store * files_ref_store_init(struct repository * repo,const char * gitdir,unsigned int flags)
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new files-based ref store with configuration options.

methods.name: void files_assert_main_repository(struct files_ref_store * refs,const char * caller)
methods.description: Ensures the operation is performed on the main repository ref store.

methods.name: struct:files_ref_store * files_downcast(struct ref_store * ref_store,unsigned int required_flags,const char * caller)
methods.description: Safely casts ref_store to files_ref_store after verifying its type and capabilities.

methods.name: void files_ref_store_release(struct ref_store * ref_store)
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the ref store, including caches and directories.

methods.name: void files_reflog_path(struct files_ref_store * refs,struct strbuf * sb,const char * refname)
methods.description: Constructs the filepath to the reflog for a given reference, considering worktree types.

methods.name: void files_ref_path(struct files_ref_store * refs,struct strbuf * sb,const char * refname)
methods.description: Constructs the filepath for a reference, considering worktree types.

methods.name: void add_per_worktree_entries_to_dir(struct ref_dir * dir,const char * dirname)
methods.description: Manually adds references related to worktrees that might not appear in main directory listings.

methods.name: loose_fill_ref_dir_regular_file
methods.description: Fills a directory node with references from a loose ref file, handling broken or unsafe refs.

methods.name: loose_fill_ref_dir
methods.description: Reads loose references from filesystem into a reference directory structure.

methods.name: for_each_root_ref
methods.description: Iterates over root references in the repository, calling a callback for each.

methods.name: int fill_root_ref(const char * refname,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Callback used during root ref iteration, fills ref dir with loose files.

methods.name: void add_root_refs(struct files_ref_store * refs,struct ref_dir * dir)
methods.description: Adds root references to the provided ref directory.

methods.name: get_loose_ref_cache
methods.description: Returns the cache of loose references, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: read_ref_internal
methods.description: Reads a reference's object ID and referent (symbolic ref), handling filesystem quirks and packed ref fallback.

methods.name: int files_read_raw_ref(struct ref_store * ref_store,const char * refname,struct object_id * oid,struct strbuf * referent,unsigned int * type,int * failure_errno)
methods.description: Reads a raw reference from filesystem or packed refs.

methods.name: int files_read_symbolic_ref(struct ref_store * ref_store,const char * refname,struct strbuf * referent)
methods.description: Reads a symbolic reference, ensuring it is a ref with REF_ISSYMREF.

methods.name: parse_loose_ref_contents
methods.description: Parses the contents of a loose ref file into object ID and referent.

methods.name: unlock_ref
methods.description: Decrements the lock's usage count and releases resources if no longer used.

methods.name: transaction_has_case_conflicting_update
methods.description: Checks if a transaction contains a case-insensitive conflicting ref update.

methods.name: lock_raw_ref
methods.description: Locks a reference for update, creating the lockfile and validating reference constraints.

methods.name: prune_ref
methods.description: Prunes a specific reference by creating a delete transaction.

methods.name: prune_refs
methods.description: Prunes a list of references scheduled for deletion.

methods.name: should_pack_ref
methods.description: Decides whether a given reference qualifies for packing based on criteria such as worktree type and symbolic status.

methods.name: should_pack_refs
methods.description: Determines whether reference packing is needed based on size heuristic and config.

methods.name: int files_optimize(struct ref_store * ref_store,struct refs_optimize_opts * opts)
methods.description: Optimizes reference storage by packing loose refs into packed-refs and pruning.

methods.name: int files_optimize_required(struct ref_store * ref_store,struct refs_optimize_opts * opts,bool * required)
methods.description: Indicates if packing is required based on current conditions.

methods.name: rename_tmp_log_callback
methods.description: Callback for renaming temporary reflog files.

methods.name: rename_tmp_log
methods.description: Renames a reflog to indicate a move operation.

methods.name: write_ref_to_lockfile
methods.description: Writes the object ID into a reference lockfile atomically.

methods.name: int commit_ref(struct ref_lock * lock)
methods.description: Commits a reference lock, finalizing the update.

methods.name: create_reflog
methods.description: Creates a reflog file for a reference.

methods.name: delete_reflog
methods.description: Deletes a reflog file for a reference.

methods.name: show_one_reflog_ent
methods.description: Parses and processes a single reflog entry line.

methods.name: for_each_reflog_ent
methods.description: Iterates over all reflog entries for a given ref.

methods.name: for_each_reflog_ent_reverse
methods.description: Iterates over reflog entries in reverse order.

methods.name: log_ref_write_fd
methods.description: Writes a reflog entry to an open file descriptor.

methods.name: update_ref
methods.description: High-level function to update a reference atomically, with reflog support.
